title: THE HALLOWEEN ISSUE · The copier
venue: the Timberline · an unpublished Halloween issue · Box 1
logline: Why the issue never ran: the library's copier at 7 AM with the Halloween pages face down on the glass, and the copier producing, instead of the pages, a single sheet — black, edge to edge, with a small white rectangle in the middle the size of a card. Wood keeps the black sheet. The pages go in Box 1. The card-sized white: reserved.
